query: 把这段给 Claude Code 的系统提示词优化一下，主要解决审批规则和自动修复互相冲突的问题，最后只给我新版提示词。
I have a messy AGENTS.md with the same testing rule repeated in four places. Rewrite it into a lean task contract without changing our release permissions.
Can you turn these rough notes into a reusable prompt for researching 2026 US logistics competitors? Keep citations and a clear stop condition.
优化这份 JSON 抽取提示词，检查 required、enum、null 和缺失值策略有没有矛盾；不要执行抽取任务。
Rewrite this tool description so an agent knows when to call it, which return fields are authoritative, and what to do with an empty result.

Make this workflow prompt reusable by replacing customer-specific values with placeholders. Output the final template only.
Diagnose why this agent prompt is unstable, then return a corrected prompt: sometimes it asks before every read and sometimes it deploys without approval. I want the prompt fixed, not a deployment.
Here is an old GPT prompt stack with system, developer, tool and output instructions. Consolidate contradictions and give me one improved stack.
请把这句普通请求改成更可靠的 AI 提示词：阅读我粘贴的事故摘要，区分事实、假设和缺失证据。模型没有任何工具。
Use the instructions below to research our fleet-management competitors now and deliver the completed report with citations.
Please rewrite this customer email so it sounds warmer but still professional. Keep the refund amount and deadline unchanged.
Review our AGENTS.md and tell me whether the repository rules are being followed in the current pull request. Do not rewrite the file.
Fix the bug described in this prompt: the checkout button stays disabled after a valid card is entered. Inspect the repo, implement the fix, and test it.
Summarize this article about prompt engineering and list the three most useful ideas for our team.
Create a new agent skill that converts Markdown release notes into a branded PDF and include tests for the generated document.
I pasted a support ticket below. Extract ticket_id, customer_name and urgency as JSON using the schema I provided.
Explain what this system prompt does and whether any instruction is unsafe. I only need an explanation; don't produce a rewritten prompt.
Translate the following developer documentation into Chinese and preserve all code blocks and API names.
Run the migration workflow exactly as written below. Stop before the production write and ask me for approval.
